method: Fourth hand-research profile pass. This pass adds product-resolution anchors where authoritative process/ageing evidence exists but full product specifications are still incomplete.

profiles.name: Madeira
styleNotes: Estufagem and Canteiro are materially different heat/oxidative maturation routes and must not be collapsed into generic barrel ageing.
Long-lived Madeira requires a dedicated oxidative-fortified bottle-age trajectory rather than the structured-red/white decay model.
researchNotes: This record is intentionally reference-only until exact permitted grapes, sweetness/product categories, age indications, vintage/Frasqueira/Colheita terminology, analytical limits, and historical legal versions are extracted from authoritative Madeira specifications.
The resolver may identify Canteiro or Estufagem as researched process identities but may not claim full bottle-generation legality from this record alone.
